items.q: In March, Education Secretary Linda McMahon laid off half of the department's workforce as part of the Trump administration's broader reduction in force efforts.

record.t: Delivered a speech on the Trump administration's K-12 accomplishments as part of her "The Next 250: American Education" series.
record.q: Secretary of Education Linda McMahon Delivers Remarks on Trump Administration’s K-12 Accomplishments

record.t: Issued a national call to action asking university presidents and governing boards to publish by the end of 2026 a public statement of commitment to reforms.
record.q: Secretary McMahon called on every postsecondary institution to publish, by the end of 2026, a clear public statement outlining its commitment to implementing reforms that will help restore public trust in higher education.

record.t: Announced a $144 million investment to help states expand interventions for students with disabilities.
record.q: Secretary of Education Linda McMahon announced a new $144 million investment by the Trump Administration to help states expand proven interventions that support students with disabilities.

record.t: Announced a proposed settlement with Missouri that would end the Biden administration's SAVE student loan plan.

record.t: Launched a "Returning Education to the States" tour to visit all 50 states.
